Per-item Eval, Regency, News reader and PDF layout checks preserve correct sibling targets.
Native receipt echoes, VCS handles, exact byte digests and rendered handles have no sampled NL producer when typed composition returns them directly.

Prepared content project actual result is a typed projection of retained native project state; see Base skills/open-user-goal/prepareContentProject.ts and its application result helper.
Root-owned packet/runbook/Calendar producers are maintained in their product-owned oracle module.
